intro.title: Webinar Series - Water Talks
intro.lede:
Our aim in the Australia India Water Centre (AIWC) is to foster knowledge exchange and collaboration among water professionals, researchers and policy makers in both Australia and India. Towards this aim we regularly organize a webinar series called “Jal Varta | Water Dialogues: Bridging Policy, Science, and Practice”

 About the Webinar Series
Titled “Jal Varta | Water Dialogues: Bridging Policy, Science, and Practice”, this webinar series is designed to provide a platform for sharing innovative ideas, research outcomes, and practical experiences in the water sector. It will feature speakers from both India and Australia, with each session focused on key water-related themes spanning science, technology, governance, and community engagement.
